name: Firewall Nation
shortBio: Firewall Nation turns distortion, rhythm and confrontation into a collision of Nu-Metal and Rap Rock.
quote: Protect your mind. Question the signal.
biography: Firewall Nation was created around the idea that music can become a firewall between the individual and the overwhelming noise of the outside world. Their sound combines aggressive guitars, rhythmic vocal delivery, electronic textures and modern production into a confrontational alternative-rock experience.
